name: Coordinator decide(issue_intake) → mint the run
description:
The run-creation station. When a front-door coordinator loop terminates with decide(action=issue_intake) — the taxonomy token for 'a new, admitted issue needs a run created from it' — mint the run via publish_agent run_scope=new. The framework mints an agent-run rooted at THIS firing coordinator loop (RunID = its own loop id), so the run entity is agent.chain.execution.<coordLoopID> in phase `dispatched`, and stamps agent.loop.run + agent.run.entity-id on this firing entity. run_scope=new requires a publish_agent, so the spawned child is a fresh coordinator wake: the run now exists, and the re-woken coordinator RE-DECIDES the next station (create_change, …). This is the semdev 'coordinator re-decides each wake' pattern (semteams coordinator/30-plan-walking), the analogue of semteams create-change/01's run-minting spawn.

FRONT-DOOR-ONLY GUARD (agent.run.entity-id length_eq 0): issue_intake means 'create a run', so this fires ONLY on a coordinator that has no run anchor yet — the bare front-door wake. It is deliberately absent on a re-woken coordinator (which inherited agent.run.entity-id from this mint), so a re-wake that also lands issue_intake cannot mint a SECOND run. Combined with run_scope=new minting rooted at the firing loop, the guard makes double-mint structurally impossible: the run is minted exactly once, by the first run-less coordinator.

The re-wake carries tool_choice=required so the coordinator stays on the decide path (semstreams#132/#158 text-only class) AND advertises a SCOPED tools list [decide, query_entity, read_loop_result, scratchpad] — decide + read tools only, never create_change/forge-io — which is the effective control at the model boundary (a provider only emits advertised tools); its prompt threads the prior decision reason so the re-woken loop has continuity. NOTE the executor now ENFORCES that advertised set at execution too (semstreams #551, landed beta.149 — see the deferred_rewake_scoping metadata). The dispatched→executing advance is owned by the agent-run bridge (01-handoff-marker → 02-dispatched-to-executing), never by product Go (G2).

on_enter.subject: agent.task.coordinator
on_enter.prompt:
SEMDEV COORDINATOR — the run now exists; continue routing the issue→PR arc.

A prior coordinator turn admitted the issue and created this run. Its decision reason: $entity.triple.coordinator.decision.reason

Read the facts recorded for the run so far and choose the single next station of the arc. Record it with the decide tool: one action from your closed taxonomy, plus a short reason. Do not do the work yourself — your job is to route.

metadata.run_entity_pattern: run_scope=new mints agent.chain.execution.<coordLoopID> (RunID = firing coordinator's loop id) in phase dispatched; agent.loop.run + agent.run.entity-id land on the firing entity; rule.task.spawned lands after the child publish succeeds (the agent-run bridge's handoff trigger).
metadata.double_mint_guard: agent.run.entity-id length_eq 0 — fires only on a run-less front-door coordinator, never a re-wake that inherited the anchor. Also blocks the re-wake (which inherits the anchor) from re-firing this rule, so the spawn chain stops at the child (no spawn storm).
metadata.rewake_scoping_resolved: RESOLVED in beta.149 (semstreams #551, the MEDIUM-3 carry-forward). The re-wake advertises a SCOPED tools list [decide, query_entity, read_loop_result, scratchpad] (decide + read tools only, never create_change/forge-io) — enforced offline by TestEveryModelSpawnDeclaresToolsAllowlist / TestRuleToolsSubsetOfAllowed. Through beta.148 this scoped list was the effective control at the MODEL boundary only (a provider emits only advertised tools); the EXECUTOR-side backstop was missing (agentic-tools gated solely on the GLOBAL allowed_tools, so a real coordinator model that emitted create_change/forge-io directly would have it executed, bypassing the routing rule that owns that transition — G2). beta.149 closed it: agentic-loop stamps agent.tools.advertised (the loop's cached tools) on every tool call and agentic-tools admitToolCall rejects a call outside the advertised set with ToolErrorPermission — so this list is now load-bearing at EXECUTION, not just advertised. Regression-guarded by TestTripwireExecutorHonorsPerLoopToolAllowlist; no longer blocks the first real-LLM token.
metadata.deferred_issue_ref: DISCHARGED (forge-io-real-lanes D2 as-built): run.issue.ref is stamped by the SIBLING rule 04-stamp-issue-ref (not this spawn rule — the run does not exist at this rule's fire time), which substitutes the front-door loop's agent.loop.task (= the wake's BARE-ref TaskID) onto the run once the anchor lands. Vocab writer moved to issue-ref-rule.
